data.gender_notes: Baza is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'az', meaning 'rich'. In Islamic tradition, Baza is a name for a boy who is expected to grow up to be a wealthy and prosperous individual. The name Baza carries the meaning “Richer, Wealthier” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baza usually hope their child will grow to embody richer, wealthier and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.long_meaning: Baza is an Arabic name derived from the verb 'بازى' (bāzā), which means to be similar or equal in value or degree. In Islamic tradition, the name Baza signifies a person characterized by generosity or elevation of status. The etymology of Baza is linked to the Arabic root 'B-Z-W', which conveys the concept of comparison or equivalence. Historically, the name has been used to denote someone of high esteem or noble character.
